QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `_MEMSAN` are documented in `mbedtls_config.h:2109-2142`. The Valgrind one is the one the CI runs... Memcheck flags secret-dependent branches as uninitialised-value use.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the Valgrind/MSan test options and says verification is dynamic in test builds, but it never says the facility is off by default or explicitly not part of the library API.
